commands.xaeronav.no_fireworks: XaeroNav: no firework rockets — you cannot gain altitude, so only the gliding part of this route is usable
hud.xaeronav.direct_distance: %d blocks away in a straight line

hud.xaeronav.incomplete: Route continues past the searched area (follow the dotted line)

gui.xaeronav.config.title: XaeroNav Settings

commands.xaeronav.mapdata_unavailable: XaeroNav: Xaero's World Map is not installed
commands.xaeronav.mapdata_summary: XaeroNav map data: %1$d blocks across — %2$d/%3$d chunks known (%4$d%%), read in %5$d ms

commands.xaeronav.probe_summary_partial: XaeroNav detail search (%1$s): did not reach (%2$d steps, %3$d nodes expanded, %4$d ms, search area %5$d×%6$d blocks)
commands.xaeronav.probe_widen_triggered: -> did not reach within the normal margin, retrying with the search area widened to the render distance
